Condition classes of condathis

Source: R/condathis-conditions.R
condathis-conditions.Rd

Every error that condathis raises has the class condathis_error, and every warning has the class condathis_warning. Each condition also has more specific classes. Use them to handle one kind of problem with base::tryCatch(), base::withCallingHandlers() or rlang::try_fetch(), and to test for it with testthat::expect_error(class = ). Do not match the text of a message: it can change in any release.

The class scheme

The classes of a condition go from the most specific to the most general:

  1. The class of the function and the problem, condathis_<function>_<problem>, with the full name of the exported function. For example, condathis_create_env_exists or condathis_run_bin_env_not_found.

  2. Older names of that class, kept so that existing handlers still work (see Renamed classes). Some classes carry further names that this page does not list: do not rely on them.

  3. Shared classes for the kind of problem, for example condathis_invalid_overwrite and condathis_invalid_arg, or condathis_env_not_found.

  4. The root class, condathis_error or condathis_warning.

The rlang package adds its own classes after these, such as rlang_error, error and condition.

For example, create_env(overwrite = "yes") aborts with the classes c("condathis_create_env_invalid_overwrite", "condathis_create_invalid_overwrite_arg", "condathis_invalid_overwrite", "condathis_invalid_arg", "condathis_error").

The checks of verbose, method and error are the same in every function, so their errors have only shared classes, for example c("condathis_invalid_verbose", "condathis_invalid_arg", "condathis_error").

Handle the most general class that fits. A handler for condathis_env_not_found catches a missing environment in every function, and a handler for condathis_error catches every error of condathis.

Shared classes

  • condathis_invalid_arg: an argument has an invalid value. condathis checks the arguments before it changes anything, so such an error has no side effects.

  • condathis_invalid_<argument>: an invalid value of one argument, with its exact name. For example, condathis_invalid_env_name, condathis_invalid_packages, condathis_invalid_channels, condathis_invalid_method, condathis_invalid_verbose, condathis_invalid_error or condathis_invalid_timeout. It always comes with condathis_invalid_arg.

  • condathis_parse_match_spec_invalid_name and condathis_parse_match_spec_invalid_url: a package spec that condathis cannot read, such as "::", or the URL of a package file whose name is not <name>-<version>-<build>. condathis reads the specs when it compares them with an existing environment, in create_env(), install_packages() and validate_env(). Also condathis_invalid_arg.

  • condathis_env_not_found: the environment does not exist. Only run(), run_bin(), run_pipeline() and install_packages() create a missing environment, and only the default "condathis-env". With error = "continue", the run family returns status 127 instead. When the environment is in the data directory of a backend whose package cannot be used (see condathis_backend_not_installed), the message names that backend.

  • condathis_backend_error: a backend failed. The function classes are condathis_<function>_failed, condathis_<function>_resolve_failed (a command or its activation could not be resolved) and condathis_backend_probe_failed. The backend's error is the parent, so rlang::cnd_inherits() finds its classes. The condathis_* classes of the backend's error are also copied, for example condathis_micromamba_status_error.

  • condathis_backend_probe_failed: a backend could not tell whether the environment exists. create_env(), install_packages() and remove_env() then stop before they change anything. Also condathis_backend_error.

  • condathis_backend_query_failed (a warning): with method = "auto", a query of one backend failed, and the function skipped that backend.

  • condathis_backend_invalid_return: a backend returned a value that breaks the contract of register_backend(). The message names the backend. Also condathis_backend_contract_violation. For the value of backend_resolve_run(), the first class is condathis_backend_resolve_run_invalid.

  • condathis_backend_contract_violation: a backend breaks the contract, when it is registered or in a return value.

  • condathis_backend_not_installed: the package of a backend that condathis knows, such as "rattler" of the rattlerthis package, is not installed. An error when method names that backend (with the classes of an invalid method). Also an error when a call would change an environment in the data directory of that backend (with condathis_backend_mismatch). A warning when a query skips the environments of that backend (once per session). Also a warning when clean_cache() cannot clean its caches.

  • condathis_backend_load_failed: the same, when the package is installed but failed to load, did not register its backend, or its backend was unregistered in this session. The error of the load is the parent. Also a warning, once per session, when condathis tried to load the package. It tries this when its backend has environments or caches, or when the option condathis.backend_priority names it.

  • condathis_link_scripts_skipped (a warning): the backend did not run the pre-link, post-link or pre-unlink scripts of some packages, which micromamba runs, so these packages may not work. The call itself succeeded. The warning has the fields backend, env_name, packages (the package names, sorted) and scripts (a data frame with the columns package and script).

  • condathis_backend_quiesce_failed (a warning): with_sandbox_dir() or clean_cache() could not tell whether a backend still works in the R process, and went on.

  • condathis_env_lock_waiting (a message, neither an error nor a warning): create_env(), install_packages() or remove_env() waits for another R session that changes the same environment (see Other R sessions in create_env()).

  • condathis_cache_lock_waiting (a message): clean_cache() waits for other R sessions that create environments or install packages, or these wait for a clean_cache() of another session.

  • condathis_env_lock_unavailable (a warning, once per session): the lock of the environment or of the package caches could not be taken, for example on a file system that cannot lock files. The call went on without it.

  • condathis_status_error: a command of run(), run_bin() or run_pipeline() exited with a status other than 0.

  • condathis_timeout_error: a command of run(), run_bin() or run_pipeline() ran longer than timeout and was killed.

  • condathis_micromamba_status_error: a micromamba command that condathis started for the micromamba backend failed. It carries the fields status and stderr, also when it is the class of a backend failure that condathis re-raised.

  • Deprecated arguments and values, which still work but will be removed (warnings). condathis_deprecated_packages_arg is for packages = in create_env(), install_packages() and validate_env() (once per session and function). condathis_deprecated_method_native is for method = "native" (once per session). condathis_deprecated_arg is for timeout_limit in install_micromamba().

Error fields

The status and timeout errors of run(), run_bin() and run_pipeline() carry these fields, so a handler does not need to read the message:

  • status: the exit status, an integer. It is -9 for a timeout, and 127 for a command that could not start. A command killed by signal n has the status 128 + n in run() on Linux and macOS, as in a shell. In run_bin() and run_pipeline(), the status is -n.

  • stdout, stderr: the captured output, or NA when that stream was not captured.

  • timeout: TRUE for a timeout, FALSE otherwise.

The errors of run_pipeline() also carry result, the condathis_pipeline result, and statuses, the status of each command.

Classes of each function

Each function also raises the shared classes above. The checks of verbose, method and error raise only shared classes.

create_env()

Arguments: condathis_create_env_invalid_packages, condathis_create_env_positional_env_name, condathis_create_env_invalid_env_name, condathis_create_env_invalid_channels, condathis_create_env_invalid_channel_priority, condathis_create_env_invalid_platform, condathis_create_env_invalid_env_file, condathis_create_env_missing_env_file, condathis_create_env_invalid_overwrite and condathis_create_env_conflicting_args (package specs and env_file). The environment: condathis_create_env_exists (it exists, and overwrite = FALSE cannot keep it) and condathis_create_env_platform_mismatch. The backend: condathis_create_env_failed, and the warning condathis_create_env_link_scripts_skipped.

install_packages()

Arguments: condathis_install_packages_missing_packages, condathis_install_packages_invalid_packages, condathis_install_packages_positional_env_name, condathis_install_packages_invalid_env_name, condathis_install_packages_invalid_channels and condathis_install_packages_invalid_channel_priority. The environment: condathis_install_packages_env_not_found. The backend: condathis_install_packages_failed, and the warning condathis_install_packages_link_scripts_skipped. The warning condathis_install_packages_missing_previous_channels says that a channel the environment was built from is not in the call. This holds on every backend that records the channels in conda-meta/history.

remove_env()

condathis_remove_env_invalid_env_name, condathis_remove_env_env_not_found, condathis_remove_env_failed, and the warning condathis_remove_env_link_scripts_skipped (pre-unlink scripts).

clean_cache()

condathis_clean_cache_failed: a backend failed to clean its caches, or condathis could not empty one of its own cache directories. A backend failure also has condathis_backend_error, with the error of the backend as the parent. For a non-zero status that the backend returned without an error, it has the fields status, stdout and stderr instead. A directory failure has the error of the deletion as the parent. condathis raises it after it cleaned the other backends and directories. A status that is not a whole number aborts with condathis_backend_invalid_return. The warnings condathis_backend_not_installed and condathis_backend_load_failed name a backend whose caches were not cleaned.

validate_env()

Arguments: condathis_validate_env_invalid_packages, condathis_validate_env_positional_env_name, condathis_validate_env_invalid_env_name, condathis_validate_env_invalid_channels and condathis_validate_env_invalid_platform. The environment: condathis_validate_env_env_not_found and condathis_validate_env_unsatisfied. The backend: condathis_validate_env_failed.

env_exists(), list_envs(), list_packages(), get_env_dir() and get_install_dir()

condathis_<function>_invalid_env_name for the functions that take env_name, condathis_list_packages_env_not_found, and condathis_<function>_failed (not for get_env_dir()).

install_micromamba()

Arguments: condathis_install_micromamba_invalid_micromamba_version, condathis_install_micromamba_invalid_timeout, condathis_install_micromamba_invalid_download_method, condathis_install_micromamba_invalid_force and condathis_install_micromamba_conflicting_args (timeout and timeout_limit). Then condathis_install_micromamba_unsupported_version and condathis_install_micromamba_download_failed. The warnings condathis_install_micromamba_checksum_unavailable and condathis_install_micromamba_checksum_mismatch concern the SHA256 check of a download.

The micromamba backend

condathis_micromamba_status_error (a micromamba command failed), condathis_micromamba_bin_path_not_executable, condathis_micromamba_version_not_detected, and condathis_micromamba_not_available_for_arch.

Replacing an environment

For create_env() with overwrite = TRUE, on every backend, three classes apply. condathis_env_set_aside_failed: the existing environment could not be moved aside, so it is unchanged. condathis_env_not_restored: the create failed and the old environment could not be moved back. The error has the field kept_env_dir with where it is kept. The warning condathis_env_restore_failed: the same after an interrupt, also with kept_env_dir. The micromamba backend adds condathis_micromamba_env_set_aside_failed and condathis_micromamba_env_restore_failed. When condathis replaces, removes or cleans up an environment, it refuses to delete or move a directory that is not exactly <root>/envs/<env_name>. The error has the class condathis_unsafe_env_dir_delete or condathis_unsafe_env_dir_move.

run() and run_bin()

Arguments, with run or run_bin as <function>: condathis_<function>_invalid_cmd, condathis_<function>_invalid_args (a value in ..., also condathis_invalid_cmd_args), condathis_<function>_invalid_input, condathis_<function>_invalid_binary, condathis_<function>_invalid_env_name and condathis_<function>_invalid_<argument> for timeout, supervise, cleanup_tree, linux_pdeathsig, stdin, stdout, stderr and, for run_bin(), activate. Then condathis_<function>_env_not_found, condathis_<function>_resolve_failed, condathis_<function>_status_error and condathis_<function>_timeout_error. A failed activation of the micromamba backend adds the classes of its error to the resolve error. On Linux and macOS, an activate.d script that exits with a non-zero status adds condathis_micromamba_status_error and condathis_cmd_status_error. A missing or unreadable activation result adds condathis_activation_dump_error, and a missing environment directory adds condathis_activation_env_not_found.

run_pipeline()

Arguments: condathis_run_pipeline_invalid_step, condathis_run_pipeline_too_few_commands, condathis_run_pipeline_conflicting_method, condathis_run_pipeline_invalid_env_name, condathis_run_pipeline_invalid_input, condathis_run_pipeline_invalid_binary and condathis_run_pipeline_invalid_<argument> for timeout, supervise, cleanup_tree, linux_pdeathsig, activate, stdin, stdout and stderr. Then condathis_run_pipeline_env_not_found, condathis_run_pipeline_resolve_failed, condathis_run_pipeline_status_error and condathis_run_pipeline_timeout_error.

run_step()

condathis_run_step_invalid_cmd, condathis_run_step_invalid_args, condathis_run_step_invalid_env_name, condathis_run_step_invalid_method and condathis_run_step_invalid_stderr.

env_path()

condathis_env_path_invalid_path (the path argument), condathis_env_path_invalid (a malformed env_path() object. It is also the second class of a path error), condathis_env_path_read_only (passed to a function that takes only names), condathis_env_path_unsupported_method (a method that names a backend that cannot run commands in such an environment, also condathis_backend_unsupported), and condathis_env_path_not_found and condathis_env_path_not_conda_env (also condathis_env_not_found).

parse_output()

condathis_parse_output_invalid_res, condathis_parse_output_invalid_stream, condathis_parse_output_invalid_trim and condathis_parse_output_binary_stream (a raw stream cannot be parsed as text).

with_sandbox_dir()

The warning condathis_with_sandbox_dir_cleanup_failed: the sandbox could not be deleted.

Backend selection (method)

condathis_backend_not_registered, condathis_backend_none_available, condathis_backend_mismatch (a change to an environment of another backend), condathis_backend_ambiguous_env (several backends have the environment), condathis_backend_not_installed and condathis_backend_load_failed (the package of the backend cannot be used), and the warnings condathis_backend_mismatch_warning, condathis_backend_marker_mismatch and condathis_invalid_backend_priority_option.

register_backend() and unregister_backend()

condathis_backend_invalid_name, condathis_backend_reserved_name, condathis_backend_root_conflict (the condathis data directory has an entry of that name that is not a directory), condathis_backend_name_conflict (the name differs only in case from another backend name), condathis_backend_class_conflict and condathis_backend_contract_violation. A backend gives its own condition the class condathis_backend_unsupported when it cannot honor an argument, and never the class condathis_backend_error.

Renamed classes

These classes of condathis 0.1.4 were renamed to follow the scheme. Each old name is kept as an extra class until condathis 1.0, so existing handlers keep working. Use the new names in new code.

New classOld class
condathis_create_env_invalid_overwritecondathis_create_invalid_overwrite_arg
condathis_create_env_missing_env_filecondathis_create_missing_env_file
condathis_remove_env_env_not_foundcondathis_error_env_remove
condathis_list_packages_env_not_foundcondathis_list_packages_missing_env
condathis_install_micromamba_download_failedcondathis_install_error_missing_bzip2
condathis_micromamba_bin_path_not_executablecondathis_umamba_bin_path_not_executable
condathis_micromamba_version_not_detectedcondathis_umamba_version_not_detected
condathis_micromamba_not_available_for_archcondathis_umamba_not_available_for_arch
condathis_micromamba_status_errorcondathis_cmd_status_error
condathis_run_invalid_cmdcondathis_run_null_cmd
condathis_run_invalid_stdin, condathis_run_bin_invalid_stdincondathis_run_stdin_error
condathis_run_bin_status_errorcondathis_run_status_error
condathis_run_invalid_args, condathis_run_bin_invalid_args (a named value)rlib_error_dots_named, rlib_error_dots

condathis_install_error_missing_bzip2 is deprecated: a failed download does not depend on bzip2.

See also

condathis-options, register_backend()

Examples

condathis::with_sandbox_dir({
  # A missing environment, in any function
  print(tryCatch(
    condathis::list_packages(env_name = "no-such-env"),
    condathis_env_not_found = function(cnd) "not found"
  ))

  # An invalid argument aborts before anything runs
  print(tryCatch(
    condathis::create_env(env_name = "my-env", overwrite = "yes"),
    condathis_invalid_arg = function(cnd) class(cnd)
  ))
})
#> [1] "not found"
#> [1] "condathis_create_env_invalid_overwrite"
#> [2] "condathis_create_invalid_overwrite_arg"
#> [3] "condathis_invalid_overwrite"           
#> [4] "condathis_invalid_arg"                 
#> [5] "condathis_error"                       
#> [6] "rlang_error"                           
#> [7] "error"                                 
#> [8] "condition"                             

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
condathis::with_sandbox_dir({
  # The fields of a status error. The command is the Rscript of this R,
  # run in the default environment, which is created empty.
  rscript <- file.path(
    R.home("bin"),
    if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") "Rscript.exe" else "Rscript"
  )
  tryCatch(
    condathis::run(rscript, "-e", "quit(status = 3)", verbose = "silent"),
    condathis_status_error = function(cnd) cnd$status
  )
})
} # }
